alerts.name: Commit at risk
alerts.action: Plan to move workloads to production; consider the Commit Burn Sprint

alerts.name: Renewal coming
alerts.action: Review usage and value with the customer before renewal talks

alerts.name: Builder surge
alerts.action: Reach out to help the new builders get to production

alerts.name: Usage spike
alerts.action: Check the setup can scale; look for expansion

alerts.name: New product
alerts.action: Share best practices for that product

alerts.name: Usage drop
alerts.action: Health check: find out what changed

types.name: Deep engagement (SA + FDE)
types.who: SA leads design and relationship; FDE builds with the customer's developers
types.what: Architecture plan, onsite, hands-on build to production

types.name: Strategic bet
types.who: SA leads with the account team; FDE only if a real project appears
types.what: Discovery meetings or an onsite to find the first use case

types.name: Scaled SA programs
types.who: SAs in group formats; no FDE
types.goal: Keep momentum going at low cost

types.name: Digital / self-serve
types.what: Docs, templates, product emails; alerts watch for change
